descriptionChirho: The proper name Gideon (Gid'on), the Israelite judge from the tribe of Manasseh who defeated the Midianites (Judges 6-8). All 39 occurrences across both clusters refer to the same individual in various syntactic positions: nominative and accusative (eng: Gideon, spa: Guidon, hin: गिदोन, arb: جِدْعُون, kor: 기드온, swa: Gideoni) and with conjunctive/prepositional prefixes (eng: and-for-Gideon, spa: para-Guidon, arb: لِـ-جِدْعُون, swa: kwa-Gideoni). The name means 'hewer/feller.'
